title: Shock response spectrum
line: A pyroshock-like transient through 60 Q = 10 oscillators.
description: Shock response spectrum of a pyroshock-like transient (Q = 10, maximax). Each natural frequency is a single-degree-of-freedom filter driven by the base acceleration, using Smallwood's ramp-invariant coefficients.
thumbnailAlt: Shock response spectrum of a decaying multi-tone transient against its peak input, rendered by RunMat
